records.title: From the fly connectome to exact ring attractor dynamics

decisions.notes: Official bioRxiv version 2 full-text HTML rechecked 2026-10-01. Methods > Experimental procedure > Fly preparation reports imaging in 6-8-day-old female UAS-jGCaMP7f;SS00096-GAL4 flies and expression of jGCaMP7f in EPG neurons. Methods > Two-photon calcium imaging states that each fly was imaged during trials in darkness. Methods > Data analysis and model fitting describes measured EPG DeltaF/F0 profiles and nonlinear least-squares fitting of the three connectome-constrained model profiles to those data. Thus the study includes its own in-vivo EPG calcium imaging; do not describe the comparison as only using previously observed profiles. The total number of flies is not stated in the checked primary text and remains unspecified. This remains a Drosophila head-direction study and supports no nociception, pain, ECAP, SCS, human clinical, or end-to-end transfer claim. The source is bioRxiv version 2 posted 2026-03-08, not a peer-reviewed accepted article.

searches.query: 10.1101/2024.11.01.621596v2 Methods Data analysis and model fitting

updates.модальность: Two-photon calcium imaging of EPG neural activity in vivo, paired with computational ring-attractor modeling constrained by fly connectomes.
updates.задача: Test whether connectome-constrained head-direction ring-attractor models reproduce EPG activity profiles measured in this study in adult female Drosophila.
updates.метод: Threshold-linear recurrent network analysis of four EPG-Delta7 connectomes, combined with two-photon jGCaMP7f calcium imaging of EPG neurons in 6-8-day-old female flies and nonlinear least-squares fitting of modeled bump amplitude and position to measured DeltaF/F0 profiles.
updates.датасет: Four Drosophila central-complex connectomes (Male CNS, hemibrain, flywire-fafb, BANC) plus in-vivo EPG calcium-imaging data from 6-8-day-old female UAS-jGCaMP7f;SS00096-GAL4 flies. The number of imaged flies is not stated in the checked primary text.
updates.производительность: Not a supervised prediction benchmark. The paper reports three connectome-constrained model realizations and fits their EPG activity profiles to calcium-imaging profiles recorded in this study; the models use shape parameters r_a=0.548, 0.437, and 0.391 for A_Delta=8, 6, and 4. No total fly count or held-out-animal test result is reported.
updates.кросс_субъект: No participant-level or held-out-animal prediction evaluation is reported. The authors fit modeled profiles to EPG imaging data collected in the study; the number of imaged flies is not stated in the checked primary text.
updates.ограничения: The paper combines computational Drosophila head-direction modeling with two-photon calcium imaging of EPG neurons in 6-8-day-old female flies. The number of imaged flies is not reported in the checked primary text and is left unspecified. The experiments concern EPG neural activity and head direction; they do not measure nociception, protective behavior, subjective pain, ECAP, SCS response, human outcomes, or a clinical chain.

evidence.population: In-vivo two-photon calcium imaging of EPG neurons in 6-8-day-old female UAS-jGCaMP7f;SS00096-GAL4 Drosophila melanogaster; jGCaMP7f was expressed in EPG neurons. Imaging trials were conducted in darkness. Total number of flies is not reported in the checked primary text.
evidence.target_label: Connectome-constrained head-direction model profiles compared with EPG calcium activity measured in the study; no nociception, pain, ECAP, or SCS labels.
